python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img31 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0031.png"))
# Check row 380 where cabinet meets floor
# Cabinet is white base at y=380
cab_x = np.where(img31[380, :, 0] > 200)[0]
print("Cabinet base at y=380, x range:", cab_x[0], cab_x[-1], "width:", cab_x[-1]-cab_x[0])

# Also check top of cabinet
for y in range(295, 315):
    if np.any(img31[y, 380:450, 0] > 230):
        print(f"Cabinet top around y={y}")
        break

# Distance to cabinet front face:
# camera pose: (0.5, 3.0), heading 0 (+y)
# ground contact y = 380.5
d = 396.8 / (380.5 - 255.5)
print(f"d = {d:.3f} m")
y_cab_front = 3.0 + d
print(f"y_cab_front = {y_cab_front:.3f}")
x_cab_min = 0.5 + (cab_x[0] - 255.5)/256 * d
x_cab_max = 0.5 + (cab_x[-1] - 255.5)/256 * d
print(f"x_cab range = [{x_cab_min:.3f}, {x_cab_max:.3f}], center = {(x_cab_min+x_cab_max)/2:.3f}")
'
